text: the camera in the iso3d building tool, is ass. is it javascript? why does it lag so hard ;_;
resolution: Diagnosed the clarified IsoAuthor building pane as the old JS-driven camera path: it was mutating IsoStage, bumping React, and rendering Scene3D.Camera position/target/fov from stage.solve(). Converted the author viewport to V23 native camera drive by binding the actual camera node id via GAME_NATIVE_CAMERA.forNode(nodeId), sending IsoStage native orbit params into the host controller, mounting Scene3D.Camera nativeCamera with a static boot pose, and setting smoothing to 0 so authoring pan/zoom/rotate does not trail. Kept IsoStage.solve for semantic boot/picking math only and added a nativeViewport guard for IsoAuthor. Verified hmsc-int bundles; nativeViewport guard passes for IsoAuthor, but the full nativeViewport suite remains red on pre-existing /voxels source state in this dirty worktree.
